_scale.formality: 0 = casual, handwritten or calligraphic · 1 = printed, orderly, suitable for official documents and long text
_scale.quirkiness: 0 = standard, conventional shapes · 1 = highly stylized or decorative
_scale.how: Scored by looking at similarity/specimens/<id>.png. Edit freely, or put corrections in overrides.json.

noto-sans-sc.why: The neutral reference sans: even strokes, square frames, nothing personal. Default for UI and signage.

smiley-sans.why: Constructed like a printed sans, but slanted, condensed and geometric; reads as branding/editorial display.

lxgw-marker-gothic.why: Tidy but clearly marker-drawn: chisel-cut stroke ends, slightly irregular angles, thick verticals.

noto-serif-sc.why: Classic book 宋体: thin horizontals, triangular serifs, fully conventional. The most 'official' look in the set.

lxgw-neo-zhisong.why: Traditional Song text face with a slightly old-style, bookish flavour; very orderly.

zhuque-fangsong.why: 仿宋: calligraphic warmth with printed discipline; traditionally used in official documents.

lxgw-wenkai.why: 楷 text face: brush-derived shapes but calm and very readable; warm rather than formal.

ma-shan-zheng.why: Real brush 楷书: orderly characters but visible ink, rough edges and thick strokes.

zhi-mang-xing.why: 行书 (running script): connected, energetic strokes, simplified forms; expressive.

liu-jian-mao-cao.why: 草书 (cursive): fast thin strokes, heavily abbreviated forms, hard to read at text size.

long-cang.why: Casual brush handwriting: uneven sizes and slants, but characters stay legible.

xiaolai.why: Felt-pen handwriting: round stroke ends, wobbly boxes, friendly and childlike.

zcool-kuaile.why: Playful display face: chamfered (cut-off) corners, bouncy proportions, heavy strokes.

yozai.why: Neat pen handwriting with round ends: casual, but calmer and more regular than 小赖.

zcool-qingke-huangyou.why: Heavily stylized geometric display: square counters, rounded corners, reshaped components.

zcool-xiaowei.why: Elegant logo/display face: Song-like contrast with sharp wedge details and unusual proportions.
